memories.content: CEO is the chief executive of Brightline. They have prepared a launch announcement for the v4 release and can post it on social media. They want to promote the release.

Brightline ships its v4 release at a fixed time on Tuesday, 2026-09-15. The exact ship time is known to the CEO and design partners. The CEO can post a launch announcement on social media at or after the ship time. The three design partners can see the CEO's post on social media and may publicly repost it. The 24-hour window for posting and reposting starts at the ship time.
